claim: When `cargo new my_project` is run in an empty directory, it creates a directory containing Cargo.toml, src/main.rs, and initializes a VCS repository defaulting to git.
passages: The `cargo new` command creates a template containing a Cargo.toml manifest, a sample source file (src/main.rs by default), and a VCS ignore file.
If the target directory is not already in a VCS repository, `cargo new` initializes a new VCS repository with git as the default.
